tasks.title: Delay is not prevention
tasks.question: Audit the stage 2 onset-delay evidence. What ages were in the randomized trial, and which evidence does the FDA label cite for younger children? Separate delay from permanent prevention.

tasks.title: What changed after diagnosis?
tasks.question: Compare C-peptide with the clinical outcomes in PROTECT. Record the age range, all prespecified key secondary results, and what the confirmatory trial intends to answer.

tasks.title: How durable is insulin independence?
tasks.question: Audit adult-only replacement evidence: denominator, follow-up, use of immunosuppression, and safety reporting. Do not infer benefit or safety for children.

tasks.title: Find the missing follow-up
tasks.question: Match pediatric or pediatric-onset trial publications to their registry IDs. Distinguish age at diagnosis from age at enrollment; record what the longest published follow-up does not answer.
